Package com.stockroom.ui.components

Class Toast

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
com.stockroom.ui.components.Toast
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable
public class Toast extends JComponent
Short-lived notification styled as a printed receipt slip.

The toast slides up and fades in at the bottom-right of its window (or of an anchor component), stays for about 2.5 seconds, then fades out. It looks like a till receipt: a surface-coloured slip with a torn, zig-zag bottom edge, a small header line with the time, a dashed rule, and the message beside a hand-drawn mark (a green tick for success, a red cross for an error, an ink dash for a neutral notice). Error toasts also have a red edge on the left.

One toast object is created per window and reused. Showing a new message while one is on screen replaces it and restarts the animation. Animation runs on a Timer, so all calls must be made on the event dispatch thread.

      private static Path2D slipOutline(int width, int bodyBottom)
      Builds the outline of the slip: a rectangle whose bottom edge is a row of torn zig-zag teeth. Coordinates are inset by half a pixel so the outline stroke is not clipped.
